script.speaker: student
script.text: Is there any chance of two more days for the essay?

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: The deadline is Friday for everyone. Why do you need longer?

script.speaker: student
script.text: I had a lab report and a presentation in the same week.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: I can accept it on Monday, but I take two points off.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Then I hand it in on Friday, even if it is shorter.

options.A: To hand the essay in on Monday
options.B: To hand it in on Friday and accept a shorter essay
options.C: To give up on the essay
options.E: To take the two point penalty

question.explain_tr: Pazartesi iki puan kaybettiriyor; öğrenci kısa da olsa cumaya yetiştirmeyi seçiyor.
question.key_line: Then I hand it in on Friday, even if it is shorter.

script.speaker: student
script.text: I can't choose between the film course and the statistics course.

script.speaker: friend
script.text: Statistics has one exam. Film has a group project every month.

script.speaker: student
script.text: I hate exams, but three projects sounds like a lot of work.

script.speaker: friend
script.text: It is. Last year half the class dropped the film course.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Then the exam is the smaller problem. Statistics it is.

question.stem: Why does the student choose statistics?

options.A: The film course is already full
options.B: One exam is less work than a project every month
options.D: Her friend is taking statistics too
options.E: The film course has an exam as well

question.explain_tr: Film dersi her ay proje istiyor; öğrenci tek sınavı daha küçük dert olarak görüyor.
question.key_line: Then the exam is the smaller problem.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Your music was loud again last night, after midnight.

script.speaker: friend
script.text: Sorry. I study late and music helps me concentrate.

script.speaker: student
script.text: I have a nine o'clock class. I can't sleep with the bass.

script.speaker: friend
script.text: What if I use headphones after eleven?

script.speaker: student
script.text: That works. And I'll stop leaving dishes in the sink.

options.A: The friend will stop studying late
options.B: The friend will use headphones after eleven
options.D: They will both sleep at eleven
options.E: The friend will wash the dishes

question.explain_tr: Arkadaş on birden sonra kulaklık kullanmayı öneriyor, öğrenci de kabul ediyor.
question.key_line: What if I use headphones after eleven?

script.speaker: student
script.text: My internship interview is at the same time as the seminar.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: The seminar has an attendance rule, but one absence is allowed.

script.speaker: student
script.text: So I don't lose anything if I miss this one?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Not this time. But use it carefully; the second absence costs marks.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Understood. I'll go to the interview and keep the rest.

question.stem: What does the staff member explain?

options.B: One absence is free, but the next one costs marks
options.C: The interview matters more than the seminar
options.D: The seminar has no attendance rule
options.E: The student will lose marks this time

question.explain_tr: Bir devamsızlık hakkı var, ikincisi not kaybettiriyor. Bu yüzden hakkını dikkatli kullanması söyleniyor.
question.key_line: But use it carefully; the second absence costs marks.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Is the yearly membership cheaper than paying each time?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: The membership is two thousand. One visit is fifty lira.

script.speaker: student
script.text: I come maybe twice a week in term time.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: That's about sixty visits a year, so three thousand. The membership wins.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Unless I stop going in March, like last year.

question.stem: What is the student's doubt about the membership?

options.A: A single visit costs more than fifty lira
options.B: She may stop going before the year ends
options.C: The gym is too far from her home
options.D: She only goes once a week
options.E: The staff member added the numbers wrongly

question.explain_tr: Hesap üyeliği ucuz gösteriyor ama öğrenci geçen yıl mart ayında bırakmış; asıl şüphesi bu.
question.key_line: Unless I stop going in March, like last year.

script.speaker: student
script.text: I left a grey bag on the ten o'clock bus.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Drivers bring lost things here at the end of the shift.

script.speaker: student
script.text: When does that driver finish?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Around six. But if there is a laptop inside, call this number now.

script.speaker: student
script.text: There is. I'll call while I wait.

question.stem: Why does the student call the number?

options.A: Because the driver finishes at six
options.B: Because there is a laptop in the bag
options.C: Because the office is about to close
options.E: Because she needs a new ticket

question.explain_tr: Görevli içinde dizüstü varsa hemen aranmasını söylüyor; öğrencinin çantasında da var.
question.key_line: But if there is a laptop inside, call this number now.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Can I do the slides instead of speaking? I panic in front of people.

script.speaker: friend
script.text: Then I speak, but you have to finish the slides by Wednesday.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Wednesday is tight. Thursday morning?

script.speaker: friend
script.text: The presentation is Thursday afternoon. I need one evening to practise.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Fair. Wednesday night, then. I'll send them before midnight.

question.stem: Why does the friend insist on Wednesday?

options.A: The slides take a long time to make
options.B: He wants an evening to practise before the presentation
options.C: The teacher asked for the slides early
options.D: He is busy on Thursday morning

question.explain_tr: Sunum perşembe öğleden sonra; arkadaş bir akşam prova yapmak istediği için slaytları çarşamba istiyor.
question.key_line: I need one evening to practise.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Can anyone take my Friday shift? I have a wedding.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Ece can, but she wants your Sunday morning in return.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Sunday morning is my only free morning.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Then ask Mert. He takes shifts for money, not for swaps.

script.speaker: student
script.text: How much does he ask?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Usually a third of the pay. Cheaper than losing the day.

question.stem: What is the difference between Ece and Mert?

options.B: Ece wants a swap, Mert wants money
options.D: Ece is free on Sunday morning

question.explain_tr: Ece karşılığında pazar sabahını istiyor; Mert ise takas değil, para karşılığı vardiya alıyor.
question.key_line: He takes shifts for money, not for swaps.

script.speaker: student
script.text: This one is cheaper, but the warranty is only one year.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: The other has three years and a free repair service.

script.speaker: student
script.text: The difference is four thousand lira. That's a lot for me.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: One screen repair costs about three thousand. Think about that.

script.speaker: student
script.text: I'll take the cheaper one and keep the money for repairs.

options.A: To buy the laptop with the longer warranty
options.B: To buy the cheaper one and save the difference for repairs
options.D: To repair her old laptop instead
options.E: To pay four thousand lira more

question.explain_tr: Uzun garantiye rağmen öğrenci ucuz olanı alıp aradaki farkı olası tamir için ayırıyor.
question.key_line: I'll take the cheaper one and keep the money for repairs.

script.speaker: student
script.text: If I leave the dorm in April, do I get any money back?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: You get the last month back only if you tell us thirty days before.

script.speaker: student
script.text: So I should hand in the form in March.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Before the tenth of March, yes. After that you pay April fully.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Then I'll bring it next week.

question.stem: When must the form be handed in?
question.explain_tr: Nisan parasının iadesi için form 10 Mart'tan önce verilmeli; sonrası tam ücret demek.
question.key_line: Before the tenth of March, yes.

script.speaker: friend
script.text: Twenty minutes by bike, forty by bus. Why do you take the bus?

script.text: Because there is no safe place to leave the bike at the faculty.

script.speaker: friend
script.text: There is a locked stand behind the library now.

script.text: Since when? That changes everything.

script.speaker: friend
script.text: Since the term started. You register your bike once, that's all.

question.stem: Why has the student been taking the bus?

options.B: There was nowhere safe to leave the bike
options.C: The bus is faster than the bike
options.D: The stand is behind the library

script.speaker: student
script.text: We have eight thousand lira for the whole term.

script.text: The photography trip alone costs five. That leaves almost nothing.

script.text: Or we do two small workshops here and keep the trip for spring.

script.text: The members voted for the trip, though.

script.text: Then we ask them again with the real numbers in front of them.

script.speaker: student
script.text: I missed the registration week. Is it completely over?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: There is a late period, but you pay a fee and choose from what is left.

script.speaker: student
script.text: So the good hours are gone.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: The morning groups usually are. Evening groups still have space.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Evening is fine. I work in the mornings anyway.

options.E: He must wait until next term

script.text: Could you write a reference for my application?

script.text: I can, but I need your grades and a short paragraph about why you want the programme.

script.text: The deadline is Monday.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: Then send everything today. I don't write references in one night.

script.speaker: student
script.text: I'll send it in an hour.

script.text: Nobody answered the group message for three days, and the plan is still empty.

script.text: Most people mute it. Try tagging them one by one.

script.speaker: student
script.text: That feels rude.

script.text: It is less rude than doing the whole project alone on Sunday.

script.text: The train is two hours faster but twice the price.

script.speaker: student
script.text: If I take the night bus I save a hotel night too.

script.speaker: friend
script.text: You arrive at six in the morning and the check-in is at two.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Students say the queue at noon is too long.

script.speaker: student
script.text: It is. I have twenty minutes between classes.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: We can open a second till, or we can start serving at half past eleven.

script.speaker: student
script.text: The second till helps everyone. The earlier time only helps the morning groups.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: That's a fair point. I'll write it in the report.

question.stem: Why does the student prefer the second till?

options.A: It costs the cafeteria less money
options.B: It helps all students, not only the morning groups
